description: This file contains the implementation of a chat UI component using Lit, including rendering logic, state management, and interaction handling for a chat application.

classes.name: ChatProps
classes.description: Type definition for properties passed to the chat component, including session info, message data, UI state flags, and callback functions.

classes.name: ChatEphemeralState
classes.description: Internal state tracking UI interactions such as slash command menu, search, and recording status.

methods.name: getInputHistory
methods.description: Retrieve or create persistent input history for a given session.

methods.name: getPinnedMessages
methods.description: Retrieve or create pinned messages manager for a session.

methods.name: getDeletedMessages
methods.description: Retrieve or create deleted messages manager for a session.

methods.name: createChatEphemeralState
methods.description: Initialize ephemeral UI state for chat interactions.

methods.name: resetChatViewState
methods.description: Reset ephemeral UI state, stop speech-to-text recording, and clear search/slash menus.

methods.name: adjustTextareaHeight
methods.description: Dynamically adjust the height of the textarea based on content.

methods.name: renderCompactionIndicator
methods.description: Render UI indicator for context compaction status.

methods.name: renderFallbackIndicator
methods.description: Render UI indicator for fallback status.

methods.name: parseHexRgb
methods.description: Convert a hex color string to RGB components.

methods.name: getThemeNoticeColors
methods.description: Retrieve theme-based warning and danger colors for context notices.

methods.name: renderContextNotice
methods.description: Render a context usage warning based on token limits.

methods.name: formatTokensCompact
methods.description: Format token counts into compact strings (e.g., 128k).

methods.name: generateAttachmentId
methods.description: Generate a unique ID for chat attachments.

methods.name: handlePaste
methods.description: Handle pasted images and add as attachments.

methods.name: handleFileSelect
methods.description: Handle file input selection for attachments.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handle drag-and-drop files for attachments.

methods.name: renderAttachmentPreview
methods.description: Render a preview of current attachments with remove buttons.

methods.name: resetSlashMenuState
methods.description: Reset slash command menu state.

methods.name: updateSlashMenu
methods.description: Update slash command menu based on input value, handling command and argument suggestions.

methods.name: selectSlashCommand
methods.description: Handle selection of a slash command, transitioning to argument selection or executing.

methods.name: tabCompleteSlashCommand
methods.description: Autocomplete slash command text without executing.

methods.name: selectSlashArg
methods.description: Select a slash command argument and optionally execute the command.

methods.name: tokenEstimate
methods.description: Estimate token count for the current draft message.

methods.name: exportMarkdown
methods.description: Export chat content as markdown.

methods.name: renderWelcomeState
methods.description: Render the initial welcome UI with suggestions.

methods.name: renderSearchBar
methods.description: Render the message search bar UI.

methods.name: renderPinnedSection
methods.description: Render the pinned messages section.

methods.name: renderSlashMenu
methods.description: Render the slash command menu UI.

methods.name: renderChat
methods.description: Main function to render the entire chat interface, including message list, input, and controls.

methods.name: groupMessages
methods.description: Group consecutive messages from the same role for display.

methods.name: buildChatItems
methods.description: Construct the list of chat items to display, including history, streams, and tool messages.

methods.name: messageKey
methods.description: Generate a unique key for a message based on its properties.
